Sam: Heads-up — planning a catalog version swap for sirocco-6b from v2026-03-01 -> v2026-03-10 tonight. Target quiet window 23:00-23:20 PT. Who can own the deploy + smoke?
Maya: I can take deploy+watching. Will be on-call tonight.
Eric: I'll be on standby for rollback and metrics checks. Which infra slot are we using?
Sam: Using dedicated slot slot-ml-12 (reserved). Deploy steps are the usual: register new model artifact, update catalog entry, then promote.
Jess: Can you paste the exact promote command? I want to review the CLI args before I grant thumbs-up. :eyes:
Sam: Sure —
Sam: ```
# register artifact (if not already)
redwoodctl model register --name sirocco-6b --version v2026-03-10 --path s3://redwood-artifacts/sirocco-6b/v2026-03-10.tar.gz
# update catalog entry (dry-run)
redwoodctl catalog update --model sirocco-6b --version v2026-03-10 --dry-run
# promote to live (actual swap)
redwoodctl catalog promote --model sirocco-6b --version v2026-03-10 --slot slot-ml-12 --grace 60
```
Maya: OK noted. I'll run the dry-run at 22:45 PT and attach outputs here.
Eric: For smoke tests I'll run the small prompt set and embedding sanity suite. If latency > 1.2x baseline or errors > 0.5% we rollback. Agree?
Jess: fine. Also add a quick check for KV cache warmup — earlier we saw cold starts on long-context flows.
Sam: Good call. Maya — can you ensure cache priming by sending these prefixes after promote: `prime_kv.sh --model sirocco-6b --slot slot-ml-12 --samples 50`
Maya: Yup. I'll run prime_kv and then start smoke suite. ETA: dry-run 22:45, promote ~23:05, smoke 23:06-23:14, final checks 23:15.
deploy-bot: [deploy job created] job_id=job-31415, slot=slot-ml-12, initiator=Maya
Sam: Rollback plan: call `redwoodctl catalog promote --model sirocco-6b --version v2026-03-01 --slot slot-ml-12 --grace 30` and then notify infra and oncall. Eric will own the rollback execution if needed.
Eric: Affirm. I'll keep the rollback command ready and watch traces for error rates in /observability/models/sirocco-6b.
Jess: Who's checking packaging/signature? We should verify artifact checksum before promote.
Sam: I'll run sha256 verify in dry-run and paste the checksum here.
Maya: Everything green on dry-run now, attaching snippet: `DRY-RUN: catalog update ok, migrations=0`
Sam: Checksum: `sha256: b1a2f3c4d5e6f7890a12b3c4d5e6f7890a12b3c4d5e6f7890a12b3c4d5e6f78` — verified.
deploy-bot: [promote started] job_id=job-31415 stage=promote ts=2234567945
Maya: Promote in progress. Starting cache priming after promote completes.
Eric: Smoke suite running now. Latency p50 92ms (baseline 85ms), p95 420ms (baseline 390ms), error rate 0.12% — within thresholds.
Jess: KV warmup looks good. No significant cold starts in the sample.
Sam: All checks pass. +1 to finalize. Maya, you can mark job done when you attach post-promote logs.
Maya: Marking job complete. Logs: job-31415 logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/logs/2234567890-promote.log
deploy-bot: [job complete] job_id=job-31415 status=success duration=540s
Eric: I'll keep monitoring overnight but nothing to action right now. Great job team. :tada:
Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll update the catalog changelog and close the ticket.
